title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Project Cardholders and Ridgeline Special Order Services Storage Charges
content:
Ridgeline Consumer Credit cardholders who put special orders or installations on their card pay a reduced storage charge on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent.

**Clause.** The cardholder rate share depends on the customer's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account: an active account with at least 2 purchases posted from special orders or installations in the last 12 months gives a share of 0.75; an active account with fewer such purchases gives 0.9; otherwise the share is 1.

The storage charge is multiplied by the cardholder rate share in the same product as the days of storage billed and the storage fee per day, before that product is rounded to the nearest cent and held to the storage cap; the share itself is never rounded.

## Records read

The customer's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account — its status — and the purchase lines posted on it whose purchase channel is special order or installation, dated within the last 12 months. Purchases from special orders and from installations are counted together.

## Share by account record

| Account status | Special-order and installation purchases in the last 12 months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| active | 2 or more | 0.75 |
| active | 0 or 1 | 0.9 |
| applied, suspended, closed, declined or charged off | any | 1 |
| no Consumer Credit account | — | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical 15 billable days at 5.00 a day)

| Account record | Charge |
|---|---|
| active, one special-order purchase and one installation purchase | 56.25 |
| active, one special-order purchase | 67.50 |
| closed | 75.00 |
